import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";

export interface Options {
  retries: number;
  onDone(result: string): void;
}

export type Mode = "fast" | "slow";

export enum Level { Low, High }

export abstract class Loader<T> implements Options {
  retries = 3;
  private readonly cache = new Map<string, T>();

  constructor(private readonly root: string) {
    secretConstruct(root);
  }

  get size(): number {
    return secretSize();
  }

  async load(path: string): Promise<T> {
    const text = await secretRead(path);
    return secretParse(text);
  }

  onDone(result: string): void { secretDone(result); }

  abstract parse(text: string): T;
}

export function createLoader(root: string): Loader<string> {
  return secretCreate(root);
}

export const double = (n: number): number => secretDouble(n);

const handler = async (event: Event) => {
  secretHandle(event);
};

export default async function* stream(): AsyncGenerator<string> {
  yield secretStream();
}

namespace Internal {
  export function helper(): void {
    secretHelper();
  }
}
